title_candidates: GitHub Copilot adds all three GPT-5.6 models
summary: GitHub Copilot is rolling out GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna across its editors, website, mobile apps, CLI, and cloud agent.

primary_source.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna are now available in GitHub Copilot
primary_source.author: GitHub
key_facts: GitHub Copilot is adding GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna to its model picker.
Sol requires Pro+, Max, Business, or Enterprise, while Terra and Luna also support Pro.
The models are rolling out across editors, github.com, mobile, CLI, and cloud agent surfaces.
Business and Enterprise administrators must enable the model policy.

prerequisites: A Copilot surface with a model picker

steps.instruction: Open Copilot Chat and check the model picker for GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna.
Ask Luna to explain one function and identify a failure case.
Repeat the identical prompt with Terra.
Use Sol only for a task that needs deeper repository-wide reasoning.
Inspect changes and run the project's checks before accepting them.

references.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna are now available in GitHub Copilot
references.author: GitHub

risk_flags: The rollout is gradual and organization policies can block access.
